channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2020-14871 — Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2020-8644 — PlaySMS PlaySMS
item.description: Threat Signal 77. PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-35395 — Realtek AP-Router SDK
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Realtek AP-Router SDK HTTP web server boa contains a buffer overflow vulnerability due to unsafe copies of some overly long parameters submitted in the form that lead to denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2020-16846 — SaltStack Salt
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

item.title: CVE-2020-6207 — SAP Solution Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

item.title: CVE-2020-14750 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2020-14882.

item.title: CVE-2020-14882 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability, which is assessed to allow for remote code execution, based on this vulnerability being related to CVE-2020-14750.

item.title: CVE-2020-10148 — SolarWinds Orion
item.description: Threat Signal 78. SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

item.title: CVE-2020-0646 — Microsoft .NET Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft .NET Framework contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-1350 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Microsoft Windows DNS Servers fail to properly handle requests, allowing an attacker to perform remote code execution in the context of the Local System Account. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of SIGRed.

item.title: CVE-2017-7269 — Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft Windows Server 2003 R2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in Internet Information Services (IIS) 6.0 which allows remote attackers to execute code via a long header beginning with "If: <http://" in a PROPFIND request.

item.title: CVE-2020-11651 — SaltStack Salt
item.description: Threat Signal 79. SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2020-6287 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 79. SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

item.title: CVE-2020-2555 — Oracle Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Multiple Oracle products contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3 or HTTP to takeover the affected system. Impacted Oracle products: Oracle Coherence in Fusion Middleware, Oracle Utilities Framework, Oracle Retail Assortment Planning, Oracle Commerce, Oracle Communications Diameter Signaling Router (DSR).

item.title: CVE-2015-4852 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-22893 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

item.title: CVE-2020-10221 — rConfig rConfig
item.description: Threat Signal 74. rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

item.title: CVE-2019-15949 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Nagios XI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in which a user can modify the check_plugin executable and insert malicious commands to execute as root.

item.title: CVE-2020-26919 — NETGEAR JGS516PE Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2018-0798 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0802.

item.title: CVE-2020-1020 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2020-10199 — Sonatype Nexus Repository
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-26411 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2012-3152 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Oracle Fusion Middleware Reports Developer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality and integrity of affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2021-20021 — SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
item.description: Threat Signal 87. SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2016-7255 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2021-1732 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-35211 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 88. SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-0541 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2016-0185 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Media Center contains a remote code execution vulnerability when Windows Media Center opens a specially crafted Media Center link (.mcl) file that references malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2020-0938 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2019-1215 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the way ws2ifsl.sys (Winsock) handles objects in memory, allowing for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-1675 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-0968 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-8759 — Microsoft .NET Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft .NET Framework contains a remote code execution vulnerability when processing untrusted input that could allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2020-0601 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI (Crypt32.dll) contains a spoofing vulnerability in the way it validates Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) certificates. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by using a spoofed code-signing certificate to sign a malicious executable, making it appear the file was from a trusted, legitimate source. A successful exploit could also allow the attacker to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and decrypt confidential information on user connections to the affected software. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of CurveBall.

item.title: CVE-2019-1429 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2015-1641 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to failure to properly handle rich text format files in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2019-0803 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability due to it failing to properly handle objects in memory causing privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2020-1147 — Microsoft .NET Framework, SharePoint, Visual Studio
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft .NET Framework, Microsoft SharePoint, and Visual Studio contain a remote code execution vulnerability when the software fails to check the source markup of XML file input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in the context of the process responsible for deserialization of the XML content.

item.title: CVE-2019-0604 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Microsoft SharePoint fails to check the source markup of an application package. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run remote code in the context of the SharePoint application pool and the SharePoint server farm account.

item.title: CVE-2019-18935 — Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

item.title: CVE-2019-11510 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.

item.title: CVE-2019-0708 — Microsoft Remote Desktop Services
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Microsoft Remote Desktop Services, formerly known as Terminal Service, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to connect to the target system using RDP and send specially crafted requests. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of BlueKeep.

item.title: CVE-2020-0674 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0143 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-40444 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-11774 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a security feature bypass vulnerability due to improperly handling objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2018-0802 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0798.

item.title: CVE-2021-26858 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.
